exams.name: Air Traffic Skills Assessment
exams.blurb: The FAA’s computer-based skills test for air traffic controller applicants measuring memory, spatial awareness and decision-making under stress.

exams.name: ATF Special Agent Entrance Exam
exams.body: Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives
exams.blurb: A written and physical assessment battery for ATF special agent candidates covering reasoning, judgment and tactical fitness.

exams.name: Border Patrol Agent Artificial Language Test
exams.blurb: A structured artificial-language test measuring an applicant’s ability to learn a new language for Border Patrol Agent hiring.

exams.name: CBP Officer Entrance Examination
exams.blurb: A multiple-choice entrance exam assessing logical reasoning, arithmetic reasoning and writing for U.S. Customs and Border Protection officer applicants.

exams.name: CBP Spanish Language Proficiency Test
exams.blurb: A language proficiency evaluation required for certain border patrol and customs positions needing Spanish communication with the public.

exams.name: Certified Commercial Contracts Manager
exams.blurb: An NCMA certification focused on commercial contracting principles, negotiation and risk for non-federal business agreements.

exams.name: Certified Federal Contracts Manager
exams.blurb: An NCMA certification for contracts professionals working on federal agreements covering FAR, acquisition planning and administration.

exams.name: Certified Professional Contracts Manager
exams.blurb: NCMA’s broadest contracts certification covering the full spectrum of commercial and government contract management competencies.

exams.name: Certified Public Manager
exams.blurb: A public-sector management credential offered through state university programs for supervisors and managers in government agencies.

exams.name: DEA Special Agent Test
exams.blurb: A multi-stage selection exam for DEA special agents evaluating logical reasoning, writing and judgment under the federal hiring process.

exams.name: Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act Certification
exams.blurb: The Department of Defense certification framework requiring acquisition professionals to meet education, training and experience standards.

exams.name: Diplomatic Security Service Agent Exam
exams.body: U.S. Department of State Diplomatic Security Service
exams.blurb: A rigorous selection exam and assessment for Diplomatic Security Service special agents protecting diplomatic missions and personnel abroad.

exams.name: FAA Air Traffic Controller Selection
exams.blurb: The full FAA hiring pathway for air traffic controllers combining the AT-SA, medical and training academy qualification for facility placement.

exams.name: FAC-C Federal Acquisition Certification
exams.blurb: The federal certification for contracting professionals, consolidated into a single Professional tier covering acquisition lifecycle competencies.

exams.name: FAC-COR Contracting Officer Representative
exams.blurb: A federal certification for contracting officer’s representatives who oversee contractor performance and government contract administration.

exams.name: FAC-P/PM Program and Project Management
exams.blurb: A federal certification for program and project managers in acquisition roles covering planning, risk and performance management.

exams.name: FBI Special Agent Phase I Test
exams.blurb: The first testing stage for FBI special agent applicants, a computer-based exam of logic, judgment and situational reasoning plus a writing sample.

exams.name: FBI Special Agent Phase II Test
exams.blurb: The second stage for FBI special agent candidates consisting of a structured interview and panel assessment of judgment and communication skills.

exams.name: Federal Air Marshal Entrance Exam
exams.body: Transportation Security Administration Federal Air Marshal Service
exams.blurb: A selection exam and assessment for federal air marshals evaluating judgment, firearms aptitude and situational decision-making.

exams.name: Federal Protective Service Officer Exam
exams.body: Department of Homeland Security Federal Protective Service
exams.blurb: An entrance exam and fitness assessment for Federal Protective Service officers guarding federal buildings and properties.

exams.name: Foreign Service Officer Qualifying Evaluation Panel
exams.blurb: The written narrative and resume review stage of the Foreign Service selection process that follows a passing FSOT score.

exams.name: Foreign Service Officer Test
exams.blurb: A three-hour multiple-choice exam on U.S. and world history, government, economics and English expression for Foreign Service Officer candidacy.

exams.name: ICE Officer Entrance Exam
exams.blurb: An entrance and assessment battery for ICE deportation and immigration officers evaluating reasoning, judgment and situational response.

exams.name: ICMA Credentialed Manager
exams.blurb: A professional credential for local-government managers demonstrating education, experience and a commitment to the ICMA Code of Ethics.

exams.name: IRS Criminal Investigation Special Agent Exam
exams.blurb: A federal selection exam for IRS criminal investigation special agents emphasizing analytical, accounting and investigative reasoning skills.

exams.name: New Jersey Civil Service Exam
exams.blurb: Merit-based competitive examinations administered by the New Jersey Civil Service Commission for state and local government positions.

exams.name: NIGP Certified Professional Public Buyer
exams.body: NIGP: The Institute for Public Procurement
exams.blurb: A mid-level NIGP certification validating the knowledge and skills of public buyers managing solicitation and award processes.

exams.name: NIGP Certified Professional Public Procurement
exams.body: NIGP: The Institute for Public Procurement
exams.blurb: The highest NIGP certification for procurement professionals covering strategic sourcing, contract management and public procurement leadership.

exams.name: NIGP Certified Public Procurement Officer
exams.body: NIGP: The Institute for Public Procurement
exams.blurb: A senior NIGP certification for procurement officers demonstrating mastery of public procurement strategy, ethics and organizational leadership.

exams.name: NYC DCAS Civil Service Exam
exams.body: NYC Department of Citywide Administrative Services
exams.blurb: The umbrella of New York City civil service examinations administered by DCAS for municipal jobs from clerical to public safety titles.

exams.name: OPM USA Hire Assessments
exams.blurb: OPM’s online assessment platform delivering structured reasoning and job-simulation tests used across many federal agency hiring announcements.

exams.name: Secret Service Special Agent Entrance Exam
exams.blurb: The written entrance exam for Secret Service special agent applicants assessing reasoning, judgment and communication skills.

exams.name: Secret Service Uniformed Division Exam
exams.blurb: A written and physical abilities exam for applicants to the Secret Service Uniformed Division protecting federal facilities and dignitaries.

exams.name: State Civil Service Examinations
exams.blurb: The collective merit-system examinations used by U.S. state governments to fill classified public-sector positions through open competition.

exams.name: TSA Computer Based Test
exams.blurb: A computer-based aptitude test for TSA officer applicants measuring object recognition, spatial reasoning and situational judgment.

exams.name: TSA Object Recognition Test
exams.blurb: A scored X-ray image test requiring candidates to identify prohibited items and threats in baggage during TSA officer screening.

exams.name: U.S. Capitol Police Officer Exam
exams.blurb: A written and physical abilities exam for U.S. Capitol Police officers responsible for protecting Congress and Capitol grounds.

exams.name: U.S. Marshals Service Criminal Investigator Exam
exams.blurb: A selection exam and assessment for deputy U.S. marshal candidates covering judgment, reasoning and the demands of federal law enforcement.

exams.name: USCIS Immigration Services Officer Exam
exams.blurb: A USA Hire-based assessment for immigration services officers evaluating reasoning, writing and judgment for adjudicating immigration benefits.

exams.blurb: A USPS pre-employment assessment for mail handler and distribution roles measuring work scenarios, personality and situational judgment.

exams.name: USPS Virtual Entry Assessment 475
exams.blurb: A USPS pre-employment assessment for mail processing clerk roles evaluating detail accuracy, personality and situational judgment.

exams.name: USPS Virtual Entry Assessment 476
exams.blurb: A USPS pre-employment assessment for mail processing and distribution roles measuring clerical speed, accuracy and judgment.

exams.name: USPS Virtual Entry Assessment 477
exams.blurb: A USPS pre-employment assessment for city carrier roles evaluating address checking, personality and situational judgment traits.
